bridgeRouteRisk.summary: BDACS's September 2026 accountant reserve report and krw1.kr name the July 2026 production KRW1 contracts on Ethereum, Avalanche and Arc, with earlier BNB Chain, Polygon and Plume deployments listed only as proof of concept. Neither issuer material nor the reviewed explorer surfaces disclose a canonical bridge, OFT/endpoint wiring, or each contract's mint and burn authority, so every tracked deployment remains an explicitly unresolved route; the aggregate tier matches that worst-route classification.

routes.reviewNote: BDACS's September 2026 accountant reserve report names this Ethereum contract as a production KRW1 deployment (18 decimals). The reviewed issuer and explorer surfaces do not establish the implementation's mint/burn controller or any peer/bridge configuration, so it cannot be classified as native issuance or a bridge representation.
